data for birdNET ## Sympatric and allopatric species ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} est <- readRDS("./data/processed/extended_selection_table_sympatric_and_allopatric_species.RDS") est <- resample_est(est, samp.rate = 48) no_mimic <- est[est$source != "mimic_bellbird" & est$species.vocalization != "P.tricarunculatus-babbling", ] table(no_mimic$species.vocalization) no_mimic$orig.sound.files <- attr(no_mimic, "check.res")$orig.sound.files # sample size table(no_mimic$source) # sample size per sound file aggregate(orig.sound.files ~ source, data = no_mimic, function(x) { length(unique(x)) }) # use caret to create a 80-20 split of the data for training and # testing the model, stratified by source + sound file # (species), keeping entire orig.sound.files levels for testing unique_orig_sound_files <- as.data.frame(no_mimic[!duplicated(no_mimic$orig.sound.files), c("orig.sound.files", "source")]) set.seed(123) # exclude pteroglossus to add it manually trainIndex <- createDataPartition(unique_orig_sound_files$source, p = 0.8, list = FALSE, times = 1) # training data no_mimic_train <- no_mimic[no_mimic$orig.sound.files %in% unique_orig_sound_files$orig.sound.files[trainIndex], ] table(no_mimic_train$source) dir.create("./data/processed/birdnet_data/train_data") # Training and testing spp <- unique(no_mimic$source) for (i in spp) { dir.create(paste0("./data/processed/birdnet_data/train_data/", i)) Y <- no_mimic_train[no_mimic_train$source == i, ] Y$start <- 0 Y$end <- 1000 exp_est(Y, path = paste0("./data/processed/birdnet_data/train_data/", i), selection.table = FALSE) } # test data no_mimic_test <- no_mimic[!no_mimic$orig.sound.files %in% unique_orig_sound_files$orig.sound.files[trainIndex], ] table(no_mimic_test$source) dir.create("./data/processed/birdnet_data/test_data") for (i in spp) { dir.create(paste0("./data/processed/birdnet_data/test_data/", i)) Y <- no_mimic_test[no_mimic_test$source == i, ] Y$start <- 0 Y$end <- 1000 exp_est(Y, path = paste0("./data/processed/birdnet_data/test_data/", i), selection.table = FALSE) } # export all at 2s long for getting embeddings dir.create("./data/processed/birdnet_data/models_and_non_models_2s") # Repeat each one till is 2 s long for (i in 1:nrow(no_mimic)) { # read only bell bird clip wv <- read_sound_file(no_mimic, i) background <- read_sound_file(no_mimic, i, from = 0.001, to = no_mimic$start[i]) wv_long <- pastew(background, wv, output = "Wave") while (duration(wv_long) < 2) { wv_long <- pastew(wv_long, background, output = "Wave") wv_long <- pastew(background, wv_long, output = "Wave") } wv_long <- cutw(wv_long, from = 0, to = 2, output = "Wave") writeWave(wv_long, filename = paste0("./data/processed/birdnet_data/models_and_non_models_2s/", no_mimic$sound.files[i], ".wav"), extensible = FALSE) } ``` ::: ## Only other bellbirds ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} other_bellbirds <- no_mimic[no_mimic$source == "Procnias tricarunculatus", ] # export all at 2s long for
